entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary:
@Agrisea  is leading the way in regenerative farming. From a garage experiment in 1996 to a global innovator today, this New Zealand company creates seaweed-based solutions that regenerate soil, strengthen crops, and improve animal health. 

They're also pushing boundaries with nanocellulose – a breakthrough material that could replace plastics and transform industries worldwide.
